utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Lovely — I’ll see you then, Noah. Just come by a little early and we’ll have tea ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll keep Thursday open and look out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Uli — I’ll confirm the details and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh great — thanks, Mina. Let me know if there’s anything I should bring for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, thanks — that sounds clear. I’ll bring the notes, and we can compare ideas on Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send the details. Thanks for helping with the next book and the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Leo — send the details when you can, and I’ll bring the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ll send the book club details soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help pick the next book and bring a few extra chairs too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Sam — thank you. I’ll send out the next steps and the reading options soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — I’m happy to help however I can once you send them along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the date, time, and book title first? I want to make sure I have the details right before I share anything else.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — it’s Thursday, and I’m still getting into the novel, so I should double-check the title before I send it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — send me the title when you’ve confirmed it, and I’ll keep the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll see you Thursday at 7 at 214 Maple Lane, and I’ll bring the details along!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for them. See you Thursday at 7!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ve got Thursday at 7 at 214 Maple Lane confirmed, and I’ll spread the word if anyone else wants to join!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can send over the shortlist, and then we can pick from the last few nominees. Does 4:30 still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 4:30 should work for me, as long as we wrap up before pickup chaos starts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send the shortlist next. Want to meet at my place or the café down the street?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice — what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not totally sure yet — can you confirm the time and place first? I’d rather not show up at the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll check and let you know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with everyone and bring the mystery pick up at book club.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep everyone posted once we know the pick.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — I’ll check in with everyone and let you know what they want to read.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s perfect—thank you, Tess. I’ll come by a little early for tea, if that’s all right!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course—that sounds lovely. I’ll be there a bit early too, and I’ll let you know if I hear what book they picked!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wonderful, thank you, Tess — I’ll look out for your message. I’ll probably forget by Thursday if you don’t remind me, so that’s much appreciated!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still deciding, but I’d love to hear the options first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — we’re meeting Thursday evening at my place, and this month we’re reading "The Glass Hotel." I can send you the address and time again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — I’ll check the library after pickup and see what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — let me know what you find out after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll swing by the library after pickup and tell you what I find.
